parts.text: Monroe Vitamin Shop sold equal quantities of Vitamin A and Vitamin D supplements this morning, even though the Vitamin A supplements come in packs of 7 and the Vitamin D supplements in packs of 17.
What is the smallest number of each type that the store could have sold?

semantic_notes: The equality preserves the stated relation between the quantities sold; pack-count integrality is implicit in the packaging statement.

assumptions: Finding the smallest positive quantity divisible into whole packs of both sizes requires least-common-multiple or integer divisibility semantics, which the active arithmetic operator registry cannot express.
